result.summary: The Rust Monster defender’s weapon-corrosion helper is missing from JavaScript. C mhitm.c:rustm() selects corrosion, rust, or fire erosion from the defender’s attack types; when an erosion type applies it always calls rn2(chance), including rn2(1) for guaranteed corrosion/rust. The existing uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_phys() JavaScript port skips the helper at two source call sites by recording note_unported('mhitm.c rustm'), so its next draw is used for unrelated monster movement and the recorded weapon erosion screen is missed.

source.branch: With non-null defender and object, choose ERODE_CORRODE before ERODE_RUST before ERODE_BURN, excluding steam vortices from fire erosion; if an erosion type is selected, call rn2(1) for corrosion/rust or rn2(6) for fire and invoke erode_obj only when the result is zero.
callers: uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_phys() call for a monster weapon striking the polymorphed hero (4106)
uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_phys() call for a monster weapon striking another monster (4182-4183)
dependencies: trap.c:erode_obj() (existing whole-function JavaScript implementation in js/trap_erode_obj.js)

evidence: At challenges/cases/v51/v51-rustmonster-passive-weapon-erosion-action-attempt2.session.json, segment 0 step 220, the admitted baseline first diverges on RNG: C logs rn2(1)=0 at mhitm.c:rustm:1278 while JS next logs rn2(3)=2. This identifies the skipped helper draw before the next monster movement.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/mhitm.c:1260-1280 defines the complete helper: null inputs return; attack types choose corrosion, rust, or fire erosion; steam vortex is excluded; fire uses chance 6; and the selected branch calls rn2(chance) before erode_obj(obj, NULL, dmgtyp, EF_GREASE | EF_VERBOSE).

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/uhitm.c:4106 and 4182-4183 call rustm from the existing mhitm_ad_phys() source unit. Its JavaScript counterpart js/uhitm.js:4962-4964 and 5043-5044 currently records note_unported('mhitm.c rustm') at both corresponding sites; the task wires the helper at both sites without claiming mhitm_ad_phys() as a newly completed source unit.
The canonical erosion callee already exists at js/trap_erode_obj.js:171 as erode_obj(); rustm discards its C return value, so no additional source function is required for this scope.
